newsitem.title: USA: St. Jude says valve implants accomplished.
newsitem.headline: St. Jude says valve implants accomplished.

text.p: St. Jude Medical Inc said the first implants of a St. Jude mechanical heart valve with Silzone anti-bacterial coating have been accomplished.

Silzone is elemental silver impregnated into the valve sewing cuff and is meant to reduce post-operative endocarditis, a serious infection that can occur following heart valve surgeries, St. Jude said.
Silzone is supplied to St. Jude Medical on an exclusive basis by Spire Corp, St. Jude said.
Twenty implants of the Silzone valves have occurred in Europe at several medical centers, the company said.
"The company plans to request approval of this valve enhancement from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration in the near future," said the medical devices manufacturer.
